text.zh: 就读肯辛顿一所高级私立预备学校；计划升入 Charterhouse，再读剑桥三一学堂。
text.en: Attends an exclusive pre-prep school in Kensington; plans to go on to Charterhouse and then Trinity Hall, Cambridge.

text.zh: 在 Charterhouse 公学就读，正是他七岁时说要去的学校。
text.en: At Charterhouse, the school he said at seven he would attend.

text.zh: 在剑桥大学三一学院读法律，正读最后一年。
text.en: In his last year at Trinity College, Cambridge, reading Law.

text.zh: 希望成为事务律师，并且“相当成功”；说取得资格后再重新考虑。
text.en: Wants to become a solicitor "and also fairly successful"; says he will rethink after qualifying.

text.zh: 曾就读 Charterhouse 公学，后在剑桥大学读法律。
text.en: Went to Charterhouse and read law at Cambridge.

text.zh: 在伦敦金融城一家大型律所任事务律师。
text.en: A solicitor working for a large firm in the City of London.

text.zh: 18 个月前与 Jane 结婚；Jane 全职做秘书。
text.en: Married Jane 18 months ago; she works full-time as a secretary.

text.zh: 平日住伦敦的公寓；周末在 Sussex 乡间改造一座旧谷仓。
text.en: A London flat during the week; weekends in the Sussex countryside, converting an old barn.

text.zh: 与 Jane 结婚；两人在父母资助下买下 Sussex 一座旧谷仓。
text.en: Married Jane; with financial help from their parents they bought an old barn in Sussex.

text.zh: 他认为在他这一行要成功，既要有法律功底，也要善于与客户相处。
text.en: Says success in his work needs legal ability plus a good "bedside manner" with clients.

text.zh: 曾就读 Charterhouse 公学和剑桥大学，在剑桥读法律。
text.en: Went to Charterhouse and Cambridge, where he read Law.

text.zh: 在伦敦金融城一家大型律所的公司业务部任合伙人。
text.en: A partner in the corporate department of a large firm of solicitors in the City.

text.zh: 与 Jane 已婚，有两个年幼的孩子 Alexander 和 Timothy。
text.en: Married to Jane, with two young children, Alexander and Timothy.

text.zh: 已从伦敦市中心搬到 Wimbledon。
text.en: Has moved from central London to Wimbledon.

text.zh: 上一部之后：两个孩子出生，搬到 Wimbledon，并成为律所合伙人。
text.en: Since the last film: two children born, a move to Wimbledon, and partnership at his firm.

text.zh: 与 Jane 一起被问到金钱与抱负时，两人的回答是：够过得舒适就是目标；有了孩子，抱负也随之改变。
text.en: Interviewed with Jane about money and ambition, they answer that having enough to be comfortable is the aim and that children change one's ambition.

text.zh: 曾就读 Charterhouse 公学和剑桥大学，在剑桥读法律。
text.en: Went to Charterhouse and Cambridge, where he read Law.

text.zh: 在金融城一家大型律所公司业务部工作，35 岁时已是合伙人；已干了 20 年。
text.en: Works in the corporate department of a large City law firm, where he became a partner by 35; 20 years in the job.

text.zh: 与全职妈妈 Jane 已婚；儿子 Alexander 快十几岁，另有 Timothy。
text.en: Married to Jane, a full-time mother; their sons are Alexander, nearing his teens, and Timothy.

text.zh: 他把一路走来归功于坚持、不愿放弃，也许还因为不太爱冒险。
text.en: Credits persistence, a dislike of giving up and perhaps not being too adventurous for pulling him through.

text.zh: 曾就读 Charterhouse 公学和剑桥大学，在剑桥读法律。
text.en: Went to Charterhouse and Cambridge, where he read law.

text.zh: 在律所干了二十多年后离开，转到一家大型工业气体公司。
text.en: Has left the law firm, after over 20 years, for a large industrial gases company.

text.zh: 与 Jane 已婚；Alexander 在纽卡斯尔读大一，Timothy 上寄宿学校。
text.en: Married to Jane; son Alexander is in his first year at university in Newcastle, Timothy at boarding school.

text.zh: 住在伦敦，乡间另有一处房子：他们改造的一座有 200 年历史的谷仓。
text.en: Lives in London, with a second home in the country: a 200-year-old barn they have converted.

text.zh: 离开工作了二十多年的律所，转投一家工业气体公司。
text.en: Left the law firm where he had worked for over 20 years to join an industrial gases company.

text.zh: 他希望孩子们成长时自己能多在家陪伴，而不是待在办公室。
text.en: Wishes he had spent more time at home with the children as they grew up, rather than in the office.

text.zh: 曾就读 Charterhouse 公学和剑桥大学，在剑桥读法律。
text.en: Went to Charterhouse and Cambridge, where he read law.

text.zh: 在一家英国大型工业公司的法务部工作；公司被德国企业收购后他保住了职位。
text.en: Works in the legal department of a large British industrial company, and kept his job after a German takeover.

text.zh: 与 Jane 结婚 28 年；Alexander 任职金丝雀码头，Timothy 刚毕业。
text.en: Married to Jane for 28 years; Alexander works in Canary Wharf, and Timothy has just graduated from university.

text.zh: 住在伦敦，乡间另有一处房子，即结婚时买下的谷仓。
text.en: Lives in London, with a second home in the country: the barn bought when they married.

text.zh: 公司被德国企业收购，他保住了工作；儿子 Timothy 大学毕业。
text.en: His company was taken over by a German firm and he kept his job; son Timothy graduated.

text.zh: 他和 Jane 说，像 Timothy 毕业、Alexander 找到第一份工作这样的时刻，最让他们感慨。
text.en: He and Jane say moments like Timothy's graduation and Alexander's first job are what make them reflect.

text.zh: 曾就读 Charterhouse 公学和剑桥大学，在剑桥读法律。
text.en: Went to Charterhouse and Cambridge, where he read law.

text.zh: 他说自己已工作 40 年，今年年底就要退休。
text.en: Says he has been working for 40 years and will retire at the end of this year.

text.zh: 与 Jane 已婚；Alexander 约三年半前成婚，Timothy 在伯明翰读计算机。
text.en: Married to Jane; Alexander married about three and a half years ago, and Timothy studies computer science at Birmingham.

text.zh: 住在伦敦，乡间另有一处房子，即结婚前后买下的谷仓。
text.en: Lives in London, with a second home in the country: the barn they bought around their marriage.

text.zh: 儿子 Alexander 约三年半前结婚；Andrew 将于今年年底退休。
text.en: Son Alexander married about three and a half years ago; Andrew will retire at the end of this year.

text.zh: 他觉得自己一直非常幸运，同时也认同这是努力换来的。
text.en: Feels he has been very fortunate, while agreeing that he worked for it.

text.zh: 他的求学之路最终止于剑桥大学三一学院。
text.en: His academic career culminated in studying at Trinity College, Cambridge.

text.zh: 上一部之后已退休；此前在一家工业气体公司任内部律师。
text.en: Retired since the last film; he had been an in-house lawyer for an industrial gases company.

text.zh: 上一部之后退休；他说花了好一阵子才适应退休生活。
text.en: Retired since the last film; says it took him quite a while to get used to it.

text.zh: 他说从 7 岁到 70 岁首尾呼应，是收尾的好时候；再拍七年就有点勉强了。
text.en: Says 7 to 70 is a good symmetry and a good time to end; another seven years might be pushing it.

text.zh: 已退休，此前工作了 40 年，最后在一家工业气体公司任内部律师。他说希望当年少把工作放在首位，多陪陪家人。
text.en: Retired after 40 years of working, latterly as an in-house lawyer for an industrial gases company. He wishes he had spent more time with his family rather than prioritising work.
